sheets.title: Travel › Coming home, a 65 MiB file — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: Settings › Vaults › Travel, coming home, with a 65 MiB file chosen as the bundle (steps: enter a return code, choose the file, press Open). Before, the page read the whole file into memory and took it as the chosen bundle; the only refusal came later, from whatever check ran first — here the code. After, the file's size is checked before a byte of it is read: the chooser is refused at once with its own sentence, no bundle is chosen, and Open stays disabled.
sheets.before: file row: not-a-bundle.travel.json (read into the page); mark: "That return code has a typo in it"
sheets.after: file row: No bundle chosen (never read); mark: "That file is larger than any travel bundle"
